cards.title: Quantum discord definition
derived_from: mutual information and optimized conditional entropy
cards.numerical_form: context for the operational zero-discord and geometric proxies

checks.reason: All entropy terms and optimization domain are explicit.
Classical-quantum states satisfy the zero-discord condition.

cards.title: Zero-discord commutator criterion
cards.numerical_form: SVD of the Hilbert-Schmidt coefficient map and pairwise commutator norms

checks.reason: The SVD, rank L, and commutator condition are explicit.
Random classical-quantum constructions have rank at most d_A and commuting left operators.

cards.title: Geometric discord
cards.numerical_form: direct minimization over a projective measurement direction

checks.reason: The norm and minimization set are explicit.
Direct dephasing distances are nonnegative and vanish for CQ states.

cards.title: Closed two-qubit formula
derived_from: quadratic minimization and largest eigenvalue of xx^T+TT^T

checks.reason: Bloch definitions and stationary point are explicit.
The closed form matches independent measurement-direction minimization.
Zero axes yield zero and Bell vertices yield one half.

cards.title: Bell-diagonal geometry
cards.numerical_form: tetrahedron, L1 octahedron, axes, and constrained quadratic extrema

checks.reason: Vertices, separable domain, axes, and claimed extrema are explicit.
Every declared physical point has nonnegative density-matrix eigenvalues.
Formula substitution exposes 1/18 at printed facet centers and 1/16 at the true separable maxima.

open_questions: The printed separable maximum 1/6 at facet centers conflicts with the formula and independent constrained optimization; fresh review is required.

cards.title: DQC1 output and trace readout
cards.numerical_form: direct block matrix and control Pauli expectations

checks.reason: The output state and normalized-trace observables are explicit.
The block matrix has trace one and reproduces both real and imaginary normalized traces.

cards.title: DQC1 zero-discord condition
cards.latex: D_A=0 iff U^dag=kU iff U=e^(i phi) A, A^2=I
derived_from: linear dependence of Hermitian and anti-Hermitian parts of U

checks.reason: The equivalence and binary-observable form are explicit.
Phase-times-involutions have commuting left Schmidt operators while all frozen Haar samples do not.

cards.title: Multipartite subsystem extension
derived_from: apply Eqs. (5)-(7) to subsystem A_j versus the tensor product of all remaining subsystems
cards.numerical_form: subsystem permutation, generalized Hermitian basis, direct coefficient-map SVD, and pairwise commutators

checks.reason: The final paragraph explicitly states extension to any number of subsystems and increasing difficulty with subsystem number and dimension.
Generalized Hermitian bases are orthonormal through local dimension five.
Fully classical multipartite mixtures commute for every party while GHZ and maximally entangled qudit states do not.
The frozen local-basis search dimension equals sum_j(d_j^2-d_j).

cards.title: Projective multipartite geometric discord
derived_from: orthogonal Hilbert-Schmidt projection onto the algebra diagonal in a fixed local product basis
optimization over U(d_j)/U(1)^{d_j} for each measured subsystem
cards.numerical_form: minimal complex-Givens coordinates and deterministic multistart minimization of the dephasing distance

checks.reason: The paper defines Hilbert-Schmidt geometric discord and explicitly says that the method and measure evaluation extend to arbitrary subsystem count, while omitting one unique multipartite formula.
The objective is a squared Hilbert-Schmidt norm and is nonnegative.
Rotated fully classical states optimize to zero for two through four qubits.
GHZ states give one half and maximally entangled qudits give 1-1/d.

open_questions: The paper states that the measure extends but does not print a unique multipartite convention; this implementation explicitly chooses simultaneous local projective dephasing and labels that choice reconstructed.

cards.title: Local-channel discord nonmonotonicity
cards.latex: rho' = sum_mu (K_mu tensor I) rho (K_mu^dagger tensor I)
derived_from: nonorthogonal prepare channel on a classical two-term state
cards.numerical_form: apply the printed prepare-channel example, then an explicit local reset channel

checks.reason: The paper states the nonorthogonal local prepare map explicitly.
Both Kraus families satisfy sum K^dagger K=I.
The initial and reset states have zero geometric discord while the nonorthogonal prepared state has nonzero discord.

cards.title: Normalized trace of a phase-times-involution
derived_from: the paper's zero-discord form U=e^{i phi}A
the +/-1 spectrum of a Hermitian involution
cards.numerical_form: multiplicity formula with direct diagonal-matrix cross-checks

checks.reason: The paper explicitly derives the phase-times-binary-observable family.
Multiplicity and explicit matrix traces agree to machine precision.

open_questions: The publication supplies no succinct input family, approximation tolerance, classical model, or hardness reduction for this subset.

cards.title: Negativity over DQC1 regrouped bipartitions
derived_from: the paper's qualitative all-bipartition entanglement statement
cards.numerical_form: all 2^n-1 unique control-grouped bipartitions for each declared DQC1 state

checks.reason: The paper explicitly quantifies over every split grouping the control with register qubits.
The control-versus-register split has zero negativity, matching the exact separable decomposition.
The enumerator returns exactly 2^n-1 unique partitions and Hermitian partial transposes.

open_questions: Negativity, the 0.02 diagnostic threshold, Haar sampling, and the finite n range are independent choices because the publication specifies none of them.
